description: |
  First launch. Used one 32in balloon and a complicted rigging system to hold the solar panel and payload underneath. The panel got caught in the rigging at launch and ended up on it's side spinning.
  A couple of attempted transmissions were received, but the WSPR packets were not long enough to decode due to probably lack of power from the tangled solar panels.
